text:
Ana (CS): Hi team — Ben from IonHealth just sent a vendor questionnaire and their audit firm is asking for temporary access to logs + key provenance during our SOC2 evidence window. Can we do a shift-left review on access options? :eyes:
Tom (Infra): Quick Q — do they want live access or just an extract?
Ben (Customer): Auditor wants read-only access to role-separated logs for 7 days, and a proof-of-key-origin (BYOK) trace. They said they "need to validate key lifecycle" for residency compliance.
Mira (Legal): We can allow scoped, time-limited access but need an NDA addendum and audit-of-auditors confirmation. Also check our DPA — some customers require evidence redaction.
Ana (CS): Noted. Proposed approach: 1) scoped read-only SRE role 2) pre-generated log bundle (SIEM export) 3) BYOK provenance snapshot signed by HSM 4) addendum template. Thoughts?
Tom (Infra): For speed I'd prefer pre-generated bundle + ephemeral console session via bastion with session recording. Session recording = meets audit chain. Example command we use to export logs:
```
export_logs --from 2026-02-01 --to 2026-02-08 --format jsonl > ion_audit_bundle.jsonl
```
Mira (Legal): Session recording + signed bundle sounds good. We must redact tenant IDs not owned by IonHealth and redact user emails. Also attach the audit addendum.
Ana (CS): Good. Ben — can you confirm auditor's contact + cert? We'll need their SOC2 report copy and a signed auditor access agreement.
Ben (Customer): Sending auditor contact now. They are from GrayOak, auditor license: GO-2025-33. I'll upload the signed access request by EOD.
Tom (Infra): One more thing — BYOK provenance: we can generate a signed artifact from our KMS that proves key import date + fingerpring. Format we can produce:
```
{
  "key_id": "redwood:byok:ion-1234",
  "imported_at": "2025-11-21T18:34:12Z",
  "origin": "customer-kms",
  "signature": "MEUCIQ..."
}
```
Mira (Legal): Perfect. Add the legal clause for "no credential retention" and confirm auditor won't export keys.
Ana (CS): I'll assemble a checklist and a one-click package we can hand to SRE. Draft checklist:
- auditor cert + contact
- signed access addendum
- redaction rules
- pre-generated log bundle + manifest
- BYOK provenance artifact
- session recording policy link
Ana (CS): @Tom can you estimate ETA to produce bundle + BYOK artifact once we have signed addendum?
Tom (Infra): ETA ~ 48 hours from signed addendum + auditor attestation. I'll queue a high-priority run.
Mira (Legal): I'll attach the addendum template here: https://redwood.internal/legal/templates/auditor-access-addendum-v2.pdf :lock:
Ana (CS): Great — I'll capture this as an onboarding task and ping Ben when ready. Ben, any timeline constraints from GrayOak?
Ben (Customer): They want it within two weeks to align with their renewal audit window. Thanks for moving fast. :pray:
Ana (CS): Copy. I'll start shift-left review now and share the package once Tom confirms. Will log next steps in the renewal playbook. :white_check_mark:
